questions.q: What units is latitude in for the wp command?
What flag does the last point have?
The RTH action code in wp?
What does p1 set for an RTH point?
questions.explain: For RTH, p1 > 0 enables landing at home; p1 is the speed in cm/s for a normal WAYPOINT.

questions.q: Why does INAV block arming with a mission loaded?
options: The first point is too far away
Missions are not allowed without a compass
questions.explain: Protection against “yesterday's mission on a different field”.

questions.q: How do you save the points to EEPROM?
questions.explain: wp save also saves any unsaved CLI settings.

options: The limit to the first point
questions.explain: The first mission point must be closer than 100 m to the arming location: protection against “yesterday's mission”.

questions.q: The waypoint acceptance radius nav_wp_radius for a wing compared to a copter:
options: Larger than for a copter: 10–30 m
Same as for a copter: about 1 m
Zero: a wing passes the point exactly
Smaller than for a copter: 10–30 cm
questions.explain: A wing doesn't stop and turns along an arc: 1000–3000 cm instead of 100 cm for a copter.
